items.name: Johnny Martin Jr.
items.tagline: Founder and visionary driving CCD's cooperative model.
items.bio: Johnny Martin Jr. is an Irvington native who founded Cooperative Community Development in January 2020 after years of watching investment promises fail to materialize in his neighborhood. Starting with a single reclaimed vacant lot in 2019, he built a member-governed co-op that now owns a 5,000 sq ft building on Frederick Avenue and operates programs across housing, food, green space, and enterprise.
items.quote: "The community does not need saving from outside. It needs ownership from within."

items.name: Robert Morina IV
items.tagline: Coordinates operations, partners, and CCD's green spaces.
items.bio: Robert keeps CCD's day-to-day moving by managing partner relationships, coordinating operations, and leading the co-op's green space work across Irvington.

items.name: Tracy Hill
items.tagline: Supports CCD's programs and handles reasonable accommodations.
items.bio: Tracy Hill supports CCD's leadership and programs, and is the point of contact for reasonable accommodations across CCD's spaces and events.

items.name: Marquita Fullard
items.tagline: Runs the Community Market and CCD's public events.
items.bio: Marquita Fullard manages CCD's events program, from the Community Co-op Market to seasonal celebrations and facilities bookings.

items.name: Alex Bull
items.bio: Alex Bull coordinates community resources at CCD, helping neighbors find the programs, services, and support they need.

items.name: Francis
items.tagline: Leads nine outdoor services across Irvington.
items.bio: Francis leads the Clean & Green crew, delivering outdoor maintenance services across Irvington and nearby communities.

items.name: Arianna
items.tagline: Keeps members and neighbors connected to the co-op.
items.bio: Arianna manages member relationships and outreach so people know what is happening, feel welcomed into the co-op, and have clear ways to get involved.
